name: agent-playbook
baseline: Version 0.5.0 workflow retained with the approved public package/skill names; compatibility creator and personal lab module removed; receipt-based 0.x migration
instruction_policy: Maintained agent instructions and agent-to-agent communication in English; direct user communication and knowledge-base prose in Russian by default, subject to explicit user language instructions; exact quotations, identifiers and required product text preserved; explicit environment/owner bindings and privacy-safe provenance; portable integration names with preserved operational safeguards

transformations.detail: Use generic user labels, neutral pronouns and grammatical sentence/heading capitalization.
